summary.en: Conan and the Detective Boys meet spider researchers who are taking pictures of a Redback spider. One of them calls their professor, but upon hearing him panic on the phone, they rush to the facility to find their professor fallen to a deadly poisonous spider.

suspects: Tooru Itokawa, Yoshiki Urasaki, and Miwa Yasuda
suspectsZh: 丝川透、浦崎义树与安田美和
